title: ALX Verification Receipt
description: Portable record of a completed ALX graph verification run.
$comment: A receipt records verification results. It is not part of Block identity and does not itself prove signature validity.

receiptVersion.description: Receipt format version. Must be '1' for v1 receipts.

protocolVersion.description: ALX Protocol version under which the graph was verified. Must be '1' for v1.

verifier.description: Identity of the implementation that produced this receipt.

root.description: blockHash of the graph root — the Block from which verification was initiated.

validationMode.description: Validation mode used: closed-world requires all parentHashes to resolve; open-world permits declared external boundaries.

ok.description: True if the graph passed structural verification under the selected validation mode.

complete.description: True if all parentHashes in the graph were resolved. False when external or missing parents exist.

blockCount.description: Number of Blocks resolved in the verified graph.

edgeCount.description: Number of parentHashes edges traversed in the verified graph.

externalParents.description: Parent hashes declared as external boundaries in the verification context.

missingParents.description: Parent hashes that could not be resolved and were not declared as external boundaries.

errors.description: Structured errors produced during verification. Non-empty when ok is false.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues noted during verification. Does not affect ok.

traceHash.description: Optional blockHash of an attribution trace associated with this verification run.
